prerequisite: None. Run this before producing profile views; it is faster than waiting for create_profile_view to fail
fixture_requirements: Alignments with a complete set (ground profile + design profile + profile view) and an alignment missing profiles (C5)
Offset alignments in the drawing (Alignment - (n)-Left-25.000), verifying they are hidden by default
One alignment carrying several profiles (ground, design, vertical curve)
assertions: Read-only operation: the drawing is not modified and no save_dwg is needed
has_ground / has_design use exactly the same rules as create_profile_view (EG|Surface / FG|Layout)
can_make_profile_view == has_ground && has_design; running create_profile_view on an alignment where it is false must fail with 'cannot identify existing ground / design profile'
the role column marks every profile as ground / design / (unrecognised); unrecognised ones must be visible at a glance
profile_views == Alignment.GetProfileViewIds().Count, matching the count from list_civil_views
with skip_offset_alignments=true, alignments named 'Alignment -...' are hidden; when alignment is specified it is listed whatever its name
profiles whose stations/elevations cannot be read lose a few fields but do not crash the row (try/catch)
alignment naming a non-existent alignment returns an empty list (no throw -- this is an inventory, not an operation)
